standard_prerequisites.use: The ring-theoretic characterization of smooth morphisms of affines (Morphisms, smooth-characterize) and the algebra lemma approximating a smooth algebra of finite presentation over a smooth algebra over a Noetherian base (Algebra, finite-presentation-fs-Noetherian); cited inputs with the translation written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Rewrite S and X as spectra of A and B and B as a smooth A-algebra.
Apply the algebra approximation lemma to obtain A_0, B_0 of finite type over Z.
Verify the resulting diagram has f_0 smooth.

proof_roadmap.step: Translate smoothness of f to a smooth algebra map.
Apply the algebra Noetherian approximation lemma for smooth algebras.

difficulty_reason: For a smooth morphism f : X -> S of affine schemes, the lemma produces the Noetherian approximation diagram of the base chapter (cartesian squares with S_0 of finite type over Z and X_0 -> S_0 of finite type) with the extra feature that f_0 is smooth. The retained proof is a written translation-then-approximation: writing S = Spec A and X = Spec B, smoothness of f makes B a smooth A-algebra by the morphisms characterization lemma, and the Algebra chapter's finite-presentation approximation lemma for smooth algebras over Noetherian bases supplies the diagram. Retained author proof at lines 9835-9842.
